message: Hi, I'm a student with a information security certification background. My overall academic average is 80% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in Management and cloud computing. I want to become a CRM Business Analyst. My family can afford at most about USD 18900 per year. I live in Mumbai. I'm open to going abroad. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.

other_constraints: Interested in Management and cloud computing

explanation:
This German program offers MSc IT Management with a very low tuition fee ($950), meets your minimum grade requirement (80%), and provides excellent job prospects in Munich with a high placement rate and post-study work visa.

Located in Germany, this MSc Information Systems program is highly affordable ($300/year), requires a manageable minimum grade (72%), and offers strong career outcomes with a high placement rate and post-study work visa.

This German MSc program focuses on Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), which is relevant to Business Analyst roles. It has a very low tuition fee ($550) and provides an excellent post-study work visa opportunity in Munich.

This Netherlands option offers MSc Information Systems with a moderate tuition cost ($13300) and is located abroad. It aligns well with your interest in business information systems while providing a post-study work visa.

This program focuses on Cloud Computing in the Netherlands and is relatively affordable ($11850). It directly addresses your interest in cloud computing while offering a post-study work visa and good career potential.
